sections.h2: What Comanche Trail Estates is like
paragraphs: This section is one of the plats that make up the Comanche Trail area, and it holds a small number of homes. Prices run from about $600,000 to $1.5 million. A voluntary HOA covers the area and there is no gate. It shares the wooded, rolling character of the peninsula without feeling like a large subdivision.
We do not assume every house here is alike. Some lots hold older homes, and others hold newer custom builds. The best way to know your windows is a photo or a window count by text.

sections.h2: What the windows here deal with
paragraphs: The shared problem is hard water. Lake air and sprinkler overspray leave white film on the glass, and the film grows stubborn on south and west facing panes. Cedar trees on the Hill Country slopes release thick pollen from December to February, and live oaks do the same in spring.
Older homes may have wood trim, aluminum frames or single hung windows that need extra care along the edges. We check the sills and seals first and work around anything that looks soft or cracked.

sections.h2: How we work Comanche Trail Estates
paragraphs: We treat the estates as part of one visit with nearby Comanche Trail streets. If a few homes ask for service the same week, the route is quick, and you can usually be on the calendar within two weeks. Windows are washed from the ground with pure water, screens are brushed and rinsed by hand, and any limestone or stucco gets a soft wash only. Pair windows with a roof soft wash if black streaks are showing from the street.
A 3,000 square foot home would run about $300 for exterior glass and take two to three hours. Adding the inside at $15 a window brings a roughly 30 window home to about $450.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: Not for exterior windows. We work from the ground with poles. For interior glass, someone should be there to let us in, and we lay drop cloths first.

faq.q: Why does my glass look cloudy after rain?
faq.a: Rain on a dusty or mineral covered window leaves a film behind. Our 7 day rain guarantee comes with Triannual, Quarterly and Every 2 Months plans, so a storm right after a visit is covered.

faq.q: Can you clean old wood framed windows?
faq.a: We can clean the glass carefully, taking care around wood and glazing. If a seal is failing we point it out rather than force water into it.

faq.q: Is there a charge for the quote?
faq.a: No. Text a few photos or a rough square footage and Tyler replies, usually within the hour during business hours. Minimum job is $200.
